minutes.headline: Board of Health granted septic and well variances for four properties and advised against holding a prom.
minutes.summary: The Board of Health met remotely and heard four septic or well variance requests. Each was moved, seconded and approved by voice vote. A fifth, 60 Woodland, was not heard because the applicant chose public water. The health agent gave a COVID update covering homebound vaccinations, a recommendation against prom, and flea market rules. The board approved the March minutes and adjourned.

votes.motion: Grant the requested septic system and well variances at 370 West Townsend Road
Accept the variances requested at 244 Pleasant Street (geomat system)
Grant the requested variances at 110 Sunset Lane consistent with the plan
Grant again the well offset variance at 809 Chase Road
Accept minutes of March 1 and March 15

decisions.decision: 60 Woodland: applicant will connect to public water; the record is to show this, and no vote was needed.
Agent's guidance on prom and school activities to be sent to all board members by the administrative assistant.
Health agent to review whether the flea market may reopen under retail and outdoor gathering standards.

what_happened.line: The Board of Health approved septic and well variances for 370 West Townsend Road, by voice vote with four ayes heard.
It then approved variances at 244 Pleasant Street for a geomat system, again by voice vote.
Variances at 110 Sunset Lane were approved consistent with the plan, and a well offset variance at 809 Chase Road was granted again.
The Woodland request was not heard: the applicant will connect to public water, so no vote was needed.
The health agent's COVID update included a recommendation against prom; the agent is to review whether the flea market may reopen.

why_it_matters: Septic and well variances let a property depart from setback rules meant to protect drinking water, so each approval affects nearby wells and, at Sunset Lane, land near Lake Shirley.
The prom recommendation and the flea market review show the board's COVID guidance reaching school events and local gatherings.
watch_next: Whether the health agent's review lets the flea market reopen under retail and outdoor gathering standards.
The agent's guidance on prom and school activities, which the administrative assistant is to send to all board members.
